product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents that extract, validate, and route document data to automate document-heavy workflows for enterprise finance, operations, logistics, and healthcare teams.
product_one_liner.notes: https://nanonets.com/about describes agents that read, validate, route, and post document data, purpose-built for accounts payable, order management, logistics, healthcare revenue cycle, and other document-heavy business processes.

pricing_page.notes: https://nanonets.com/pricing is a public plans page, including an Enterprise plan with custom pricing and deployment requirements; it is not merely a contact form.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer logo wall at https://nanonets.com/agents names Roche and Ryanair. | named_customers.0: Roche appears on the customer logo wall at https://nanonets.com/agents. | named_customers.1: Ryanair appears on the customer logo wall at https://nanonets.com/agents.

employee_band.notes: https://linkedin.com/company/nanonets reports 327 associated employees, placing it in the 201-500 band. Other profiles give differing counts, so this is a supported band rather than an exact payroll figure.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://nanonets.com/about identifies “Where we are” as San Francisco and gives a San Francisco business address. This supports the headquarters location, although the page does not explicitly label it “headquarters.” | hq_country: https://nanonets.com/about identifies San Francisco, California, and gives its Market Street address. This establishes the United States, although the country is inferred from the address rather than spelled out.

founded_year.notes: The company profile at https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nanonets explicitly lists “Founded: 2017.”

eng_blog.notes: The research index at https://nanonets.com/research describes how its models are built and evaluated. Two substantive model-development posts qualify: https://nanonets.com/research/nanonets-ocr-3, credited to Nanonets Research, explains MoE architecture and mixed-resolution training; https://nanonets.com/research/nanonets-ocr-2/index.html, by Souvik Mandal, describes a three-million-page dataset and synthetic-to-manually-annotated training. Research authorship is established, though the bylines do not explicitly state engineering job titles.

public_docs.notes: https://docs.nanonets.com/ is a public documentation site containing multiple distinct articles, including team roles, instant learning models, and workflow setup.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/nanonets lists a Deep Learning Engineer role, with its live posting at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/nanonets/jobs/5372370008.

model_provider.notes: https://nanonets.com/ explicitly identifies Nanonets OCR-3 as “our proprietary model,” directly establishing a publicly disclosed model used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance area at https://nanonets.com/ names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR alignment, and HIPAA with a BAA available for enterprise plans. These are the company's public claims; the wording does not imply that HIPAA or GDPR is an independently issued certification. | compliance_certs.0: https://nanonets.com/ explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: https://nanonets.com/ explicitly names ISO 27001 compliance. | compliance_certs.2: https://nanonets.com/ names HIPAA and says a BAA is available for enterprise plans. | compliance_certs.3: https://nanonets.com/ explicitly claims GDPR alignment.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: https://nanonets.com/blog/nanonets-raises-29-million-in-series-b calls the round Series B, and the funding record identifies that round as the most recent. | funding_date: The announcement at https://nanonets.com/blog/nanonets-raises-29-million-in-series-b is dated March 12, 2024. The funding record identifies this as the latest round, yielding 2024-03. | funding_amount_usd: https://nanonets.com/blog/nanonets-raises-29-million-in-series-b explicitly announces $29 million. The answer uses the company's announced dollar amount rather than the slightly different amount recorded by a funding database.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is the March 12, 2024 Series B, announced at https://nanonets.com/blog/nanonets-raises-29-million-in-series-b. That date precedes the eighteen-month window beginning in May 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/nanonets/jobs/5219252008 is a live Enterprise Account Executive application page and explicitly says the company is seeking that role.

launched_6mo.notes: https://www.producthunt.com/products/nanonets/launches/atlas-40 records the Atlas product launch on June 26, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated profile at https://linkedin.com/in/mishra-shubhra records a Nanonets Vice President Strategic Initiatives role beginning March 2026, within the twelve-month window. The profile establishes the role start, rather than providing a separate appointment announcement.
